steps: Nameplate current = kVA × 1000 / (√3 × winding voltage). Primary 90.2 A; secondary 208.2 A.

Primary Table 450.3(B) ceiling: 250% = 225.5 A. No next-standard exception. Modeled standard-device range is 15–4000 A; a reported modeled maximum is not the full table ceiling when that ceiling exceeds the device range.

Secondary Table 450.3(B) ceiling: 125% = 260.2 A. Only the 125% cell permits the next standard size. Modeled standard-device range is 15–4000 A; a reported modeled maximum is not the full table ceiling when that ceiling exceeds the device range.
warnings: Maximum modeled permitted OCPDs are table limits, not recommended or selected breakers. No actual load, conductor size or installation suitability is inferred from nameplate current.
